title: Martin to address O'Connor sacking amid call for clarity
story: Taoiseach Micheál Martin is expected to address the sudden removal of HSE Chief Executive Anne O'Connor from her role in the Dáil
. Opposition politicians are demanding greater clarity on the sacking of Ms O'Connor but Minister for Health Jennifer Carroll MacNeill insists the
was exclusively a matter for members of the HSE board, whom she said are independent but have her support. The Government is expected to face sustained questioning on the developments in the Dáil

Leaders' Questions - with the Green Party calling for time to be set aside for a special Dáil debate. Members of the Dáil's Committee of Public Accounts and the Oireachtas Health Committee will also consider their next steps throughout the day - as they
for greater scrutiny of the events leading to Ms O'Connor's sacking. Last
, Mr Martin met Tánaiste Simon Harris, the leader of Independent TDs in Government Sean Canney and Ms Carroll MacNeill.
